# Unity ERP by Unity Software Solutions
> All-in-one cloud ERP + CRM + AI for growing businesses. Affordable alternative to Odoo, Salesforce, Sage, and QuickBooks — with free trial and deep integrations.

Site: https://www.unity-software.online
Company: Unity Software Solutions
Regions: Kenya, South Africa, Egypt
Contact: erpintergration@gmail.com | +254 793 832 286
Pricing: KES 3,000/month or KES 33,000/year (1 month free). Unlimited users on standard plan.
Trial: 2-month free trial — full modules, no credit card required.
Payment: https://checkout.swypt.io/erp

## Why Unity ERP
- Cheaper all-in-one pricing vs many Odoo, Salesforce, Sage, or QuickBooks stacks when you need ERP + CRM + inventory together
- CRM and ERP in one system (not separate tools)
- Built-in AI Assistant for sales, stock, and finance questions on live data
- Strong fit for manufacturing, retail POS, construction, hospital, education, agriculture, hospitality, logistics, finance
- Free custom business website design for active customers (royalty benefit)
- Integrations-ready: API, webhooks, payments (incl. M-Pesa ecosystem), accounting and commerce platforms

## Core modules (100+ capabilities overview)
### CRM & Sales
Lead capture, deal pipeline, activities, follow-ups, quotes, customer history, sales targets, conversion tracking, email touchpoints, multi-user sales teams

### Inventory & Warehouse
Multi-warehouse stock, bins, transfers, reorder points, stock adjustments, batch tracking, low-stock alerts, barcode-ready workflows, POS stock deduction

### Purchasing
Purchase orders, supplier records, goods receipt, vendor performance, landed cost visibility, reorder suggestions

### Finance & Accounting
Chart of accounts, invoices, bills, payments, receivables, payables, bank reconciliation helpers, period reports, multi-currency readiness, tax-aware invoicing

### Manufacturing
BOM, work orders, WIP, finished goods, scrap notes, batch costing, production scheduling basics

### Retail & POS
Fast checkout, multi-branch retail, daily cash-up, promotions-ready structure, customer profiles at POS

### HR & Payroll
Employee records, onboarding basics, time-off, payroll processing support, compliance-oriented records

### Projects & Services
Job costing, project tracking, progress billing patterns for construction and services

### AI Assistant (Knight AI)
Natural-language sales summary, inventory alerts, finance insights, purchase recommendations, operational Q&A on live ERP data, role-aware answers

### Platform
Unlimited users (standard plan), cloud hosting, backups, role-based access, reports & analytics, API access, webhooks, multi-branch, audit-friendly activity

### Integrations
REST API, webhooks, payment gateways, M-Pesa-friendly commerce flows, e-commerce order import patterns, SMS alerts, BI/export, QuickBooks/Xero-style accounting export patterns, Zoho/Odoo migration-friendly data model mindset
